name: ESDS Software Solution Ltd
tagline: Nashik-based cloud / data-centre / GPU-as-a-Service player that listed 2026-09-04 at a 76% premium and has since gone near-parabolic (Rs 429 issue -> ~Rs 1,308, ~Rs 12,800 Cr mcap, multiple upper circuits) - FY26 financials are genuinely strong (+28% revenue, +117% PAT, ~50% EBITDA margin) and it is a clean data-centre/AI theme hit, but zero public track record and a now-indefensible ~106x trailing P/E
business_overview: One of only two Indian players claimed to offer the full spectrum of GPU-as-a-Service (GPUaaS), cloud, managed services and data-centre infrastructure plus software, largely serving government/BFSI and enterprise customers (MeitY-empanelled). IPO priced at Rs 429/share, raised ~Rs 720 Cr fresh issue (~Rs 576 Cr earmarked for cloud/DC infrastructure), listed on NSE/BSE 2026-09-04 at a ~76% premium and hit upper circuits for several sessions after. No ValuePickr thread yet - web-only, first-week-of-listing assessment.
fundamentals_table: ~Rs 12,777 Cr (price ~Rs 1,308, 8-Sep-2026; up from ~Rs 8,873 Cr at listing price on repeated upper circuits)
Rs 472.2 Cr, +28% YoY (FY24 Rs 286.5 Cr -> FY25 Rs 361.3 Cr -> FY26 Rs 472.2 Cr)
Rs 120.8 Cr, +117% YoY (FY24 Rs 13.6 Cr -> FY25 Rs 55.6 Cr -> FY26 Rs 120.8 Cr)
Operating profit Rs 234 Cr (~50% margin, up from ~35% in FY24); PAT margin ~25.6%
Low leverage (D/E ~0.08 pre-IPO); interest expense fell Rs 31.6 Cr (FY24) -> Rs 11.8 Cr (FY26); net cash post-IPO
~27x trailing sales / ~106x trailing PAT at ~Rs 1,308 - already extreme, and running ahead of fundamentals on post-listing momentum
~Rs 576 Cr of IPO proceeds earmarked for cloud-computing/data-centre infrastructure

fundamentals_narrative: FY26 numbers (per the RHP) are genuinely excellent for a company of this scale: 28% revenue growth compounding into 117% PAT growth, operating margin expanding from ~35% to ~50%, falling interest cost, and a rising cross-sell rate (62% -> 89% of customers on all three service lines) that points to real stickiness. It is a clean hit on the live priority-1 data-centre / hyperscale / AI-infrastructure theme (GPUaaS + cloud + DC infra). Two hard caveats, both now sharper than at the first read: (1) zero public-market or post-IPO-disclosure track record - the first quarterly results as a listed company have not been reported; (2) the stock has roughly tripled from a rich IPO price to ~Rs 1,308 (~Rs 12,800 Cr, ~106x trailing PAT, ~27x sales) in its first week on repeated upper circuits, so the entry valuation now embeds years of flawless compounding with negative margin of safety. Margin durability (~50% operating margin) is itself unproven against GPUaaS pricing competition and hyperscaler pressure.
